_what: Triset seed batch 'web2' — 90 more deceptively simple scenes with hooks at three levels (Sophie's ask, 2026-08-31: 'can u make 90 more. remember, the accident about to happen was just an example'). L3 concepts widened to ~17 threads, two dictated by her: BROKEN APART (her card: a mirror cracked into pieces, a different body part in each one) and A MESS (her card: q-tips scattered on the floor). Each thread has 3+ cards so 'all same' sets exist; cards cross-link on L1 (cracks, coils, stripes, dots, drips, red round, white triangles) and L2 (bathroom, kitchen, street, pets, winter, night) with different partners per level, and hook into web1 + the original pool.
